mapper.sql: cps.id AS id, cps.type_id AS typeId, CASE cps.type_id WHEN 1 THEN 'Internal' WHEN 2 THEN 'External' END AS typeName, cps.description AS description, cps.resolution_number AS resolutionNumber, cps.base_on_id AS baseOnId, hwh.name AS baseOnName, ( SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(egroups.name SEPARATOR ', ') FROM egroups WHERE egroups.id IN ( SELECT egroup_id FROM crm_support_pipeline_setting_egroups WHERE crm_support_pipeline_setting_id = cps.id ) ) AS employeeGroupName, GROUP_CONCAT(cos.name ORDER BY cpss.ordering DESC SEPARATOR ', ') AS stageName, GROUP_CONCAT(CONCAT(FORMAT(cpss.percent, 0), '%') ORDER BY cpss.ordering DESC SEPARATOR ', ') AS percentage, GROUP_CONCAT(cpss.ordering ORDER BY cpss.ordering DESC SEPARATOR ', ') AS ordering, cps.created AS created, CONCAT(creator.first_name, ' ', creator.last_name) AS createdBy, cps.modified AS modified, CONCAT(modifier.first_name, ' ', modifier.last_name) AS modifiedBy

FROM crm_support_pipeline_settings AS cps LEFT JOIN crm_support_pipeline_setting_stags AS cpss ON cpss.crm_support_pipeline_setting_id = cps.id LEFT JOIN crm_support_stags AS cos ON cos.id = cpss.crm_support_stag_id LEFT JOIN hr_working_hours AS hwh ON hwh.id = cps.base_on_id LEFT JOIN users AS creator ON creator.id = cps.created_by LEFT JOIN users AS modifier ON modifier.id = cps.modified_by

WHERE cps.is_active = 1 AND cps.id IN ( SELECT crm_support_pipeline_setting_id FROM crm_support_pipeline_setting_egroups WHERE egroup_id IN ( SELECT egroup_id FROM employee_egroups WHERE employee_id IN (SELECT id FROM employees WHERE user_id = #{userId}) ) )
AND cps.description LIKE CONCAT('%', #{filter.searchText}, '%')
mapper.select:
SELECT
WHERE cps.is_active = 1 AND cps.id = #{id} GROUP BY cps.id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO crm_support_pipeline_settings(type_id, description, resolution_number, base_on_id, created, created_by, is_active) VALUES (#{pipeline.typeId}, #{pipeline.description}, #{pipeline.resolutionNumber}, #{pipeline.baseOnId}, NOW(), #{pipeline.createdBy}, #{pipeline.isActive})
mapper.update: UPDATE crm_support_pipeline_settings SET type_id = #{pipeline.typeId}, description = #{pipeline.description}, resolution_number = #{pipeline.resolutionNumber}, base_on_id = #{pipeline.baseOnId}, modified = NOW(), modified_by = #{pipeline.modifiedBy} WHERE id = #{pipeline.id} AND is_active = 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO crm_support_pipeline_setting_stags(crm_support_pipeline_setting_id, crm_support_stag_id, percent, ordering, is_skippable) VALUES (#{pipelineId}, #{stageId}, #{percent}, #{ordering}, #{skippable})
mapper.select: SELECT cpss.crm_support_stag_id AS stageId, cos.name AS stageName, cpss.percent AS percent, cpss.ordering AS ordering, cpss.is_skippable AS skippable FROM crm_support_pipeline_setting_stags AS cpss INNER JOIN crm_support_stags AS cos ON cos.id = cpss.crm_support_stag_id WHERE cpss.crm_support_pipeline_setting_id = #{pipelineId} AND cos.is_active = 1 ORDER BY cpss.ordering ASC

SELECT cssa.crm_support_activity_id FROM crm_support_stag_activities AS cssa INNER JOIN crm_support_activities AS csa ON csa.id = cssa.crm_support_activity_id WHERE cssa.crm_support_pipeline_setting_id = #{pipelineId} AND cssa.crm_support_stag_id = #{stageId} AND csa.is_active = 1 GROUP BY cssa.crm_support_activity_id
